scope: Focused arithmetic, claims, sector-substitution and evidence-to-conclusion audit of the three original pilots and r002 corrections.

reviewer.identity_limit: Configuration known; no backend model-identity attestation available.

additional_review.configured_model: inherited parent configuration; not independently identified

review_boundary: Astra independently reproduced four APP cases and inspected final residual corrections/test records. Parent executed final mutations and visual checks. Astra did not rerun final mutation tests or test native Excel.

findings.finding: Borrowing created cash without linked debt service and claims.
findings.resolution: Reject every nonzero borrowing input until a separately validated financing schedule exists.

findings.finding: Growing total terminal FCFE conflicted with constant financing interest.
findings.resolution: Value growing pre-interest operating equity cash and constant after-tax interest separately.

findings.finding: Blank and domain guards did not protect all dependent outputs.
findings.resolution: Guard selected inputs, dates, sensitivities and terminal cash; bank selectors and supporting outputs; scope-compatible Unilever TTM and margins. 122 mutation checks recorded.

findings.finding: Rounded USD3.6bn debt was treated as exact USD3600m principal.
findings.resolution: Record December 2025 detailed USD3550m note principal and distinguish dates, carrying values and cash interest.

findings.finding: Known ownership evidence omitted from uncertainty assessment.
findings.resolution: Record July outstanding shares and December disclosed awards. Mixed-date EPS proxy explicitly remains unapproved as a current claim count.

findings.finding: Ownership sensitivity and bank capital comparison exceeded their scope.
findings.resolution: Restrict 5% ownership scaling to zero fixed-cash buybacks; attribute Advanced versus Standardized total-capital comparison precisely.
335.989m is explicitly July outstanding plus June EPS awards; December note principal is separately dated.

findings.finding: Sensitivity cells lacked positive terminal-FCFE checks at each growth setting.
findings.resolution: Each grid cell validates its own terminal cash, rate domains and active inputs; targeted negative-terminal fixture passes.

findings.finding: Invalid JPM selector could error or truncate fractional values.
findings.resolution: Require a numeric integer in 1..4 before CHOOSE; blank, zero, negative, 5, fractional and text cases withheld.

findings.finding: Missing quote broke workbook case and artifact validation.
findings.resolution: Support WITHHELD price-dependent returns while retaining conditional valuation arithmetic. Actual no-quote export/import fixture validated.

findings.finding: Bank helper bypassed finite/non-boolean numeric validation.
findings.resolution: Validate all bank numeric inputs; NaN, infinity, boolean and invalid domains rejected.

findings.finding: XIRR fixed lower bound could report an incorrect near-total-loss return.
findings.resolution: Solve in log(1+r), validate bracketing and residual; extreme-loss and unrepresentable-loss tests added.

APP: Mature reinvestment and margin persistence unsupported.
Lease/cash-interest financing and current ownership claim reconciliation incomplete.
June-to-October cash/operating bridge and independent valuation corroboration incomplete.
Intrinsic value, investment judgement, accepted prospective returns and actionable entries withheld; displayed numbers are conditional arithmetic illustrations.
JPM: Reported average ROTCE is not automatically a long-run return on opening tangible equity.
No capital-constrained forward distribution path verified; steady-state values are illustrative.
No accepted price-dependent return or entry conclusion.
ULVR: Focused IFRS/scope/currency validation only, not a full company thesis.
Price and FX absent; security valuation and prospective returns withheld.

per_stage_cost: Unavailable; account snapshots are shared and not precise task costs.
followup_disposition: Conditional valuation can use materially bounded dated snapshots; corrected r002 is still illustrative. Broader operating WC needs financing-accrual correction before reuse. New replacement model not part of this completed focused audit.
